statement: Declared outcome plans are bound to actual returned data, including the retained live-finance result, and checked for variant matching, negative outcomes, unpresentable shapes, delivery states and the distinctness of missing, null and zero.

retainedEvidence.note: One retained execution. Read as data; nothing was re-executed.

cases.case: the retained live-finance outcome matches its declared variant
observed price binds to the actual returned value
currency is bound from its own declared pointer
market time is bound separately from retrieval
domain disposition carries its declared label
provider testimony is presented as evidence, not as the result
quote record preserves each field with its own presence
zero is a present value, not an absence
an absent pointer reports as missing
a negative domain outcome selects its own declared variant
negative outcomes preserve counts without changing their domain disposition
the positive variant is selected by its own discriminator
an eligible count of zero is presented, not hidden
an empty collection reports its declared empty text
an undeclared contract is refused, not rendered
a right contract with an undeclared disposition is refused, not rendered
a refusal is a delivery state and preserves the draft
an uncertain delivery is recoverable and never auto-resubmitted

notEstablished: No capability was invoked. The outcome used here is retained evidence from an earlier run, read as data.
A live price must be compared to its own retained provider testimony; a previous run's price is not an expected constant.
